premises.text: Biometric and behavioral factors can build a unique digital fingerprint for authentication
premises.evidence_span: we use biometric and behavioral factors to build a unique digital fingerprint of you and use that to authenticate and secure your identity

premises.text: Implicit authentication can eliminate the need for passwords
premises.evidence_span: once you install Unify ID, you don't need to deal with passwords or authentication again

premises.text: Sensor data from devices can be used to authenticate users
premises.evidence_span: Unify ID uses the recent sensor data from your phone, computer, wearables, and other nearby devices

premises.text: The system can distinguish between different users based on their unique behaviors
premises.evidence_span: we can actually distinguish between my walking and Kurt's walking just from the phone in our pocket

premises.text: UnifyID can reduce fraud and prevent account takeover
premises.evidence_span: UnifyID has applications in streamlining authentication, reducing fraud, and preventing account takeover

premises.text: The technology can be applied to both online and offline use cases
premises.evidence_span: we see this extending for offline use cases as well, for example, with IoT devices

premises.text: The solution addresses specific problems like account takeover and password resets
premises.evidence_span: one of our partners has a big problem with account takeover, and we're working with them to incorporate UnifyID's technology on their website and on their mobile app

premises.text: The founders have relevant experience in cybersecurity and machine learning
premises.evidence_span: We're a group of cybersecurity and machine learning experts from MIT, Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU

value.text: Authentication becomes more secure and user-friendly through implicit authentication
value.evidence_span: we believe the best way to authenticate yourself is to be yourself
